The 8 Java builders use no stylesheet. Six of them (simple-flat-owl, simple-owl,
legacy-rdfs and their -augmented forms) use SchemaGenerator subclasses
(OWLGenerator, RDFSGenerator, via RDFSBasedGenerator), which traverse ProfileClass
objects directly and emit OWL/RDFS triples into a result OntModel; ttl writes the
profile model directly, and xml serializes it with ProfileSerializer alone:
The resulting OntModel is then serialized to RDF/XML directly, bypassing
ProfileSerializer entirely. Reorganizer and its subclasses (ProfileReorganizer,
SchemaReorganizer) are not part of either path: they run from the profile
editor's Repair and Reorganize wizard to make a profile conform to the
